posts.title: Update 1.2.4: Launcher Themes
posts.text: Volt now offers **THEMES** that can be downloaded in the shop!!! to use a downloaded themes either hit apply on the downloaded theme in the store or go to setting and scroll to launcher themes and click on the drop down menu you installed themes will appear there. more will come in the future and with them I plan to give you all possibly a more user friendly version of the Volt tool box with is a separate html that can be used to create and publish themes and a multitude of other **UGC** related content.
